title: Chiho Saitō's VS Lupin Manga Ends
content: The summer issue of Shogakukan 's Zōkan Flowers magazine published the final chapter of Chiho Saitō 's VS Lupin manga on Tuesday. The manga, based on the original thief Arsène Lupin by French novelist Maurice Leblanc , launched in the inaugural issue of Zōkan Flowers in 2012.
author: ANN

title: Solo Leveling: Ragnarok Gets One Step Closer to Return With New Release This October
content: Solo Leveling is all set for its anticipated film after making fans wait for more than a year since the Season 2 finale. The anime wrapped up the fan-favorite Jeju Island Arc in Season 2, leaving behind several questions for fans to answer.
author: ComicBook

title: Harukana Receive's Nyoijizai Launches New Manga
content: Manga author Nyoijizai launched a new manga titled Shinkon Dakedo Captain no Kanojo to wa Mada Yarenai ( I'm newly married, but I still can't have sex with the captain's girlfriend ) on Kadokawa 's Dra Dra Sharp# online manga magazine last Saturday. The manga centers on newlywed couple Yūto and Asuka.
author: ANN

title: Manga Creator matoba Launches New Fantasy Series on August 12
content: The August issue of Square Enix 's Monthly Shonen Gangan magazine revealed last Friday that manga creator matoba will launch a new series titled Eden no Tō : Luluchikakunia to Tō no Meikyū (Tower of Eden: Luluchikakunia and the Tower Labyrinth) in the magazine's next issue on August 12.
author: ANN

title: Solo Leveling Officially Silences the Biggest Worry About Its Upcoming Film
content: Solo Leveling officially announced that it would be returning with a movie during the latest Anime Expo, and since then, a lot of news has surfaced about the project. title: 5 Anime Remakes That Actually Lived Up To The Hype
content: Anime has become a mover and shaker in the entertainment world, as you can’t seem to escape some of these classic animated figures taking over the small screen, the silver screen, and more. Another way that classic anime franchises have stayed relevant is by remaking their original stories using modern technology.

title: New Sword Art Online Movie Confirms Its Place in the Anime’s Timeline
content: Sword Art Online is now in the works on a new movie, and it has confirmed that it’s finally going to be moving the anime’s story forward with its confirmed place in the timeline.

title: Real Girl's Mao Nanami Launches New Manga on July 26
content: Mao Nanami announced on July 4 that she will launch a manga adaptation of Ryō Midorikawa 's Tensei Hakushaku Lilina no Kekkon (The Marriage of the Reincarnated Countess Lilina) light novel in Square Enix 's Gangan Online service on July 26.
